say:1:1522102001:1.text: Do you remember me, Lady Merlin? I'm Kalis, Samu's mother.
say:1:1522102001:1.source_cn: 梅林女士，您还记得我吗？我、我是卡莉斯，小赛穆的妈妈。

say:2:1522102002:0.text: Last time, when his fever wouldn't break, you saved him with your magic...
say:2:1522102002:0.source_cn: 上次小赛穆高烧不退，是您出手救了他，治好了他的病……

say:3:1522102003:0.text: I'm begging you. Please, save him again!

choice_prompt:4:1522102003.text: I'm begging you. Please, save him again!

say:5:1522102004:0.text:
Samu... yes, I remember.
The poor little boy curled in your arms.
say:5:1522102004:0.source_cn: 小赛穆……我记得他。\n那可怜的、依偎在你怀中的男孩。

say:7:1522102006:0.text: I-I don't know, but it's not a normal illness! Something's terribly wrong. <style="highlight">Only your magic can save him!</style>
say:7:1522102006:0.source_cn: 我、我不知道……但肯定不是普通的病！他病得很诡异，<s...

say:9:1522102007:0.text: A sick child needs a doctor, not a bunch of mages. Go home!
say:9:1522102007:0.source_cn: 孩子生病就该看医生。找这群魔法师有什么用？快回去！

say:10:1522102008:0.text: I can't afford a doctor... And all the good ones were drafted as army medics!
say:10:1522102008:0.source_cn: 我哪有钱带小赛穆看医生……而且那些好医生都被你们拉去当...

say:11:1522102009:0.text: Lady Merlin, please! I'm begging you! Save my child! He's all I have!
say:11:1522102009:0.source_cn: 梅林女士，求求您，求求您救救我的孩子吧——！

say:13:1522102010:0.text: Don't worry. I won't turn my back on a life in need.
say:13:1522102010:0.source_cn: 无需忧虑，我不会对一个珍贵的生命袖手旁观。

say:14:1522102011:0.text: Where is he now? Take us to him.
say:14:1522102011:0.source_cn: 小赛穆现在在哪？请带我们过去。

say:15:1522102012:0.text: Thank you... Thank you so much!

say:0:1522103001:0.text: This way. He's at home. He hasn't woken up in days...
say:0:1522103001:0.source_cn: 跟我来。小赛穆在家里，他一直昏迷不醒……

say:0:1522105001:0.text: And what's that old charlatan doing here?
say:0:1522105001:0.source_cn: 那个没什么学问的学者老头怎么也在？

say:1:1522105002:0.text: Doesn't matter, Morgan. Let's focus on the boy.
say:1:1522105002:0.source_cn: 那不重要，摩根。小赛穆的情况更为重要。

say:3:1522106002:0.text: I've seen this before. It's <style="highlight">that cursed locust meat</style> again.
say:3:1522106002:0.source_cn: 这副模样太眼熟了。恐怕又是<style=highlig...

say:5:1522106003:0.text: You again?! You corpse-defiling scoundrel! What are you doing in Halia?
say:5:1522106003:0.source_cn: 怎么又是你？！你这个亵渎尸体的无耻之徒！跑到呼临城来做什么！

say:6:1522106004:0.text: Lygos, why are you with them? Where's Perseus?
say:6:1522106004:0.source_cn: 隆尔，你为什么跟着他们？珀尔修斯呢？

say:8:1522106005:0.text: Perseus ordered me to watch over them. He said they're here to meet the Regulus.
say:8:1522106005:0.source_cn: 就是珀尔修斯下令让我看着他们的。他说这群人要见领主。

say:9:1522106006:0.text: What?! That... that's outrageous! These shameless—
say:9:1522106006:0.source_cn: 什么？！这——这怎么行！这群无耻的——

choice_prompt:10:1522106006.text: What?! That... that's outrageous! These shameless—
choice_prompt:10:1522106006.source_cn: 什么？！这——这怎么行！这群无耻的——

say:12:1522106010:0.text: Calm down, Mr. Bakis. We already know what's wrong with Samu. A little magic is all it takes to heal him.
say:12:1522106010:0.source_cn: 学者，请冷静。我们已经明确了小赛穆虚弱的原因，只需要一...

say:13:1522106011:0.text: All the medicine in the world wouldn't help like this magic can.
say:13:1522106011:0.source_cn: 即使你通晓世间全部药理，也难以和这一点魔力相比。

say:16:1522106013:0.text: Master Bakis, please! Lady Merlin saved Samu's life once before. I trust her. Samu does too! Please don't drive her away!
say:16:1522106013:0.source_cn: 比博大人，梅林女士曾经救过小赛穆的命。我相信她，小赛穆...

say:17:1522106014:1.text: I know who she is. Merlin, of the Arcane Council. That's why I'd rather she stayed away!
say:17:1522106014:1.source_cn: 我当然知道她是梅林，魔法师协会的人。否则我也不会赶她出去！

say:18:1522106015:0.text: But you claim she saved your child? Is that true?
say:18:1522106015:0.source_cn: 但你刚说她曾救过你孩子的命，这事是真的吗？

say:19:1522106016:0.text: Yes, of course it's true! I can bring witnesses if you need proof!
say:19:1522106016:0.source_cn: 是啊，当然是真的！如果你不信，我可以找人作证！

say:20:1522106017:0.text: Hmph... for the sake of this boy, I'll allow you to remain in Halia, for now.
say:20:1522106017:0.source_cn: 哼……鉴于这孩子的病情，我暂且允许你们在城内停留。

say:21:1522106018:0.text: But the one in black robes—he stays under Lygos' watch. He's not to go near any of our people!
say:21:1522106018:0.source_cn: 但是，那个穿黑袍的人——必须时刻在隆尔的看守下，绝不能...

say:23:1522106019:0.source_cn: 多虑了，我本来也没这个打算。

say:24:1522106020:1.text: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <male>him</male> do the work.
say:24:1522106020:1.source_cn: 这还有个新人呢。有什么事我会使唤<male>他</ma...
say:24:1522106020:1.male: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <male>him</male> do the work.
say:24:1522106020:1.female: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <female>her</female> do the work.

choice_prompt:25:1522106020.text: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <male>him</male> do the work.
choice_prompt:25:1522106020.source_cn: 这还有个新人呢。有什么事我会使唤<male>他</male><female>她</female>的。
choice_prompt:25:1522106020.male: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <male>him</male> do the work.
choice_prompt:25:1522106020.female: And we have a rookie here. I'll make <female>her</female> do the work.

say:26:1522106021:0.text: Well, we can't have our precious Merlin lifting a finger, can we?
say:26:1522106021:0.source_cn: 总不能让我们亲爱的梅林亲自动手。
say:26:1522106021:0.male: Well, we can't have our precious Merlin lifting a finger, can we?
say:26:1522106021:0.female: Well, we can't have our precious Merlin lifting a finger, can we?

say:28:1522106023:0.text: Hold on. This isn't right. They're—

say:29:1522106024:0.text: What's not right? You'd rather stand here and watch him die?
say:29:1522106024:0.source_cn: 有何不妥？难道你要眼睁睁看着这孩子丢了命吗！

say:30:1522106025:0.text: Focus on your own job. Leave the rest alone!
say:30:1522106025:0.source_cn: 做好你份内的事，其他的事不要多嘴！

say:34:1522106027:0.text: Kalis, before Samu fell ill, did he eat any locust meat? Those bug-like monsters in the wilderness?
say:34:1522106027:0.source_cn: 卡莉斯，小赛穆发病之前是不是食用过针蝗的肉？针蝗就是野...

say:35:1522106028:1.text: Y-yeah... A few days ago, he snuck some in while I wasn't looking. Ate the whole thing...
say:35:1522106028:1.source_cn: 是……是的。前几天，他趁我不注意，不知道从哪弄来一块蝗...

say:36:1522106029:0.text: But your general said no one's to eat those things.
say:36:1522106029:0.source_cn: 但你们的统帅应当已经下令，禁止食用针蝗。

say:37:1522106030:0.text: I know... but we had nothing left to eat. Samu was starving.
say:37:1522106030:0.source_cn: 我、我知道……可是没有食物，小赛穆又那么饿……

say:38:1522106031:0.text: As soon as I found out, I tried to stop him! But it was too late...
say:38:1522106031:0.source_cn: 我一发现就立刻制止了！可是，可是他已经吃下去了，吐也吐...

choice_prompt:39:1522106031.text: As soon as I found out, I tried to stop him! But it was too late...
choice_prompt:39:1522106031.source_cn: 我一发现就立刻制止了！可是，可是他已经吃下去了，吐也吐不出来……

say:41:1522106033:0.text: Don't fault a mother in distress. She's not to blame.
say:41:1522106033:0.source_cn: 不要指责一位忧心的母亲，这不是她的错。
say:41:1522106033:0.male: Don't fault a mother in distress. She's not to blame.
say:41:1522106033:0.female: Don't fault a mother in distress. She's not to blame.

say:42:1522106034:0.text: Please, if your magic works, prove it. Heal him. If he recovers, you can move freely around the city—except for the one in black.
say:42:1522106034:0.source_cn: 请你们救醒这孩子，证明你们的魔法有效。只要他能康复，我...

say:43:1522106035:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, help me <style="highlight">heal Samu</style>. He'll get better faster if we do it together.
say:43:1522106035:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, help me <style="highlight">heal Samu</style>. He'll get better faster if we do it together.
say:43:1522106035:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, help me <style="highlight">heal Samu</style>. He'll get better faster if we do it together.

choice:39:0:1.text: You need to watch your child.
choice:39:0:1.male: You need to watch your child.
choice:39:0:1.female: You need to watch your child.

say:46:1522106007:0.text: Then that black-robed one shouldn't be desecrating the dead!
say:46:1522106007:0.source_cn: 若真是如此，那穿黑袍的家伙就不该亵渎死者！

say:48:1522106009:0.text: I'm not letting you anywhere near him. Get out! Leave Halia!
say:48:1522106009:0.source_cn: 我不可能让你们触碰这孱弱的孩子！走，离开呼临城！

choice:10:2:3.text: Keep arguing and the boy will die!
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 再啰嗦下去，这孩子就要没命了
choice:10:2:3.male: Keep arguing and the boy will die!
choice:10:2:3.female: Keep arguing and the boy will die!

say:0:1522107001:0.text: Come on, let's heal Samu with our magic.
say:0:1522107001:0.source_cn: 来吧，用我们的魔力治疗小赛穆。
say:0:1522107001:0.male: Come on, let's heal Samu with our magic.
say:0:1522107001:0.female: Come on, let's heal Samu with our magic.

say:1:1522108001:1.text: Samu... Oh gods, your hands—they're warm again!
say:1:1522108001:1.source_cn: 小赛穆……天啊，你的手终于暖和起来了……
say:1:1522108001:1.male: Samu... Oh gods, your hands—they're warm again!
say:1:1522108001:1.female: Samu... Oh gods, your hands—they're warm again!

say:2:1522108002:1.text: Incredible... Just like that, he's stabilized. His breathing's calmer too.
say:2:1522108002:1.source_cn: 不可思议……不过一眨眼的时间，这孩子的病情就稳定下来了...

say:3:1522108003:0.text: I still don't believe it's a curse, but this isn't any normal illness...
say:3:1522108003:0.source_cn: 虽然无法认同你们所说的诅咒，但我也确信这不是一般的病症……

say:5:1522108004:0.text: Yeah... Lady Merlin's magic never lets us down!
say:5:1522108004:0.source_cn: 是啊……梅林女士的魔法一直都这么神奇！

say:6:1522108005:1.text: Make sure you take good care of him. He'll wake up soon.
say:6:1522108005:1.source_cn: 好好照顾小赛穆。他很快就会从昏迷中苏醒。

say:9:1522108007:0.text: Either way, thank you both. You saved his life.
say:9:1522108007:0.source_cn: 无论如何，我要感谢你们两位伸出援手，救这孩子一命。
say:9:1522108007:0.male: Either way, thank you both. You saved his life.
say:9:1522108007:0.female: Either way, thank you both. You saved his life.

say:10:1522108008:0.text: Still, just to be safe, you <style="highlight">can't leave</style> until he wakes up.
say:10:1522108008:0.source_cn: 不过，保险起见，在这孩子苏醒之前，你们<style=h...
say:10:1522108008:0.male: Still, just to be safe, you <style="highlight">can't leave</style> until he wakes up.
say:10:1522108008:0.female: Still, just to be safe, you <style="highlight">can't leave</style> until he wakes up.

say:11:1522108009:0.text: You think we'd hurt an innocent child?
say:11:1522108009:0.source_cn: 你疑心我们可能伤害一个无辜的孩子？

say:12:1522108010:1.text: You mages mingle with the Wildborn and corpse-defiling scoundrels. I have every reason to be cautious.
say:12:1522108010:1.source_cn: 你们魔法师协会与兽人和亵渎尸体的无耻之徒同行，我必须提防。

say:17:1522108013:0.text: Pff, yeah right! If your magic hadn't just proven useful, I'd have had Lygos toss you out of the city by now!
say:17:1522108013:0.source_cn: 你干的亵渎之事已经够多了！要不是刚刚的魔法有效，我早让...

say:18:1522108014:0.text: Once the boy wakes up, you're free to go. I won't stop you from meeting with Abundius either. I hate what you did with the dead, but your magic helped the living.
say:18:1522108014:0.source_cn: 等这孩子平安醒来以后，你们自然可以离开。觐见阿邦德的事...

choice_prompt:19:1522108014.text: Once the boy wakes up, you're free to go. I won't stop you from meeting with Abundius either. I hate what you did with the dead, but your magic helped the living.
choice_prompt:19:1522108014.source_cn: 等这孩子平安醒来以后，你们自然可以离开。觐见阿邦德的事我也不会再阻拦。虽然你们亵渎死者，但魔法对生者还有用。

say:20:1522108015:0.text: In that case, I'll prepare another herbal remedy, one that anyone can make, to ease symptoms from eating needle locusts.
say:20:1522108015:0.source_cn: 既然如此，我会再写一个普通人也可制作的药方，用以应对食...

say:21:1522108016:0.text: Mr. Bakis, if you trust me, share the remedy with the rest of the city.
say:21:1522108016:0.source_cn: 学者，若是你信得过我，可以将这个药方公布于全城。

say:22:1522108017:0.text: Let's wait until the boy's awake, Merlin.
say:22:1522108017:0.source_cn: 等这孩子醒来再说吧，梅林。

say:23:1522108018:0.text: Guess if I want your trust, I'd better stop helping Merlin.
say:23:1522108018:0.source_cn: 看来为了取信于你，我也不能帮梅林了。

say:25:1522108019:0.text: Don't try anything funny. I've got my eyes on you.
say:25:1522108019:0.source_cn: 别动坏脑筋，我一直盯着你呢。
say:25:1522108019:0.male: Don't try anything funny. I've got my eyes on you.
say:25:1522108019:0.female: Don't try anything funny. I've got my eyes on you.

say:5:1522111004:1.male: Keeps sticking her nose in Halia's affairs.
say:5:1522111004:1.female: Keeps sticking her nose in Halia's affairs.

say:6:1522111005:0.text: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.
say:6:1522111005:0.source_cn: 从我们向兽人宣战开始，她就三番五次地来到呼临城，请求觐...
say:6:1522111005:0.male: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.
say:6:1522111005:0.female: Ever since we declared war on the Wildborn, she's been hounding our gates, demanding to see the Regulus.

say:7:1522111006:0.text: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!
say:7:1522111006:0.source_cn: 阿邦德不肯见她，她就敢直接找上珀尔修斯和我！真是不知天...
say:7:1522111006:0.male: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!
say:7:1522111006:0.female: Abundius won't meet with her, so she goes straight to me and Perseus! The nerve!

say:8:1522111007:0.text: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
say:8:1522111007:0.source_cn: 如果她不改变她的态度，就算她再字字珠玑，再直点要害，呼...
say:8:1522111007:0.male: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

choice_prompt:9:1522111007.female: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

say:10:1522111008:0.text: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!
say:10:1522111008:0.source_cn: 那又如何？置之死地而后生！就是因为呼临城被天灾逼上了绝...
say:10:1522111008:0.male: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!
say:10:1522111008:0.female: Exactly! That's why we fight! When you're cornered by famine and disaster, you've got nothing left to lose. We took the Wildborn camp because we had no choice!

say:11:1522111009:0.text: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.
say:11:1522111009:0.source_cn: 我看你还像是个明事理的人，劝你一句，别再妄想和平，更别...
say:11:1522111009:0.male: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.
say:11:1522111009:0.female: You seem like you've got some sense. So here's my advice: Stop chasing peace. Stop showing up in Halia thinking words can fix this.

say:12:1522111010:0.text: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.
say:12:1522111010:0.source_cn: 和平和战争，早已不是哪个人或是哪几个人就能够决定的了。
say:12:1522111010:0.male: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.
say:12:1522111010:0.female: The days when one person could choose peace or start a war are long gone.

choice_prompt:13:1522111007.text: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!
choice_prompt:13:1522111007.source_cn: 如果她不改变她的态度，就算她再字字珠玑，再直点要害，呼临城也不会听从她的劝诫。她那点嘴皮功夫，不如去劝兽人与我们和谈，或许还唬得住！

choice_prompt:13:1522111007.female: Unless she changes her tone, it won't matter how clever her words are. Halia won't listen. She'd have better luck sweet-talking the Wildborn!

say:14:1522111011:0.text: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.
say:14:1522111011:0.source_cn: 你不明白。政治不是一门简单的课程。
say:14:1522111011:0.male: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.
say:14:1522111011:0.female: You don't get it. Politics isn't something you learn from a book.

say:15:1522111013:0.text: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.
say:15:1522111013:0.source_cn: 别再打听了。事关呼临城内政，我不可能告诉你那么多。
say:15:1522111013:0.male: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.
say:15:1522111013:0.female: That's enough. Halia's affairs aren't your concern.

say:16:1522111014:1.text: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.
say:16:1522111014:1.source_cn: 你们只要知道，和平和战争都不易，这就足够了。
say:16:1522111014:1.male: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.
say:16:1522111014:1.female: Just know this—peace costs something. War costs more. That's all you need to understand.

say:18:1522111012:0.text: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.
say:18:1522111012:0.source_cn: 声望和民心有时是同一个东西，有时又不是。
say:18:1522111012:0.male: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.
say:18:1522111012:0.female: Reputation and public support... sometimes they go hand in hand. Sometimes they don't.

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 珀尔修斯不是很有声望吗？

choice:9:0:1.text: The Wildborn fight harder than you.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔人可比你们勇猛多了
choice:9:0:1.male: The Wildborn fight harder than you.
choice:9:0:1.female: The Wildborn fight harder than you.

choice:9:1:2.text: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 遭受饥荒的可不是雅库伯尔
choice:9:1:2.male: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!
choice:9:1:2.female: The Wildborn aren't the ones starving!

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我是为了拯救呼临城而来！

say:19:1522111003:1.text: She has. Stubborn, arrogant, always meddling. I don't like her.
say:19:1522111003:1.source_cn: 是的。执拗又骄傲的年轻人，我不喜欢她这种人。
say:19:1522111003:1.male: She has. Stubborn, arrogant, always meddling. I don't like her.
say:19:1522111003:1.female: She has. Stubborn, arrogant, always meddling. I don't like her.

narration:0:1522112001:0.text: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.
narration:0:1522112001:0.source_cn: 周围已没什么令你在意的人或事，因此你安静地等待着
narration:0:1522112001:0.male: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.
narration:0:1522112001:0.female: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.

narration:1:1522112002:0.text: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.
narration:1:1522112002:0.source_cn: 半晌之后，小赛穆终于睁开了眼睛
narration:1:1522112002:0.male: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.
narration:1:1522112002:0.female: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.

say:3:1522112003:0.text: He's awake... Samu! My baby, you're awake!
say:3:1522112003:0.source_cn: 醒了……小赛穆，我的孩子！你终于醒了！

say:4:1522112004:0.text: Oh thank goodness! Hurry, see if the child's okay!
say:4:1522112004:0.source_cn: 太好了，快看看孩子有没有事！

say:7:1522112006:0.text: Oh, sweetheart... Mommy will get you something. Just hold on...
say:7:1522112006:0.source_cn: 可怜的孩子……妈妈这就去给你找吃的……

say:8:1522112007:0.text: Don't trouble yourself. I've got half a ration of bread left. Let the boy have it.
say:8:1522112007:0.source_cn: 别折腾了。我能从配给能省下半块面包，拿给孩子吃吧。

say:9:1522112008:0.text: Thank you... thank you so much...

say:11:1522112009:1.text: Samu's safe, Mr. Bakis. I trust that's enough to convince you the Arcane Council means no harm.
say:11:1522112009:1.source_cn: 既然小赛穆无恙，学者，我想你会相信魔法师协会的善意。

say:12:1522112010:0.text: This is the remedy I promised. It'll help ease the symptoms, but it's not a cure. The curse runs deeper than any sickness, and only magic can fix it.
say:12:1522112010:0.source_cn: 这是我方才写好的药方，可以缓解相同的症状，但根治只能依...

say:13:1522112011:0.text: We won't be staying in the city. You won't always have us around. This should help your people hold out until more mages arrive.
say:13:1522112011:0.source_cn: 我们三人不会一直留在城内，不能随叫随到。依靠这份药方，...

say:14:1522112012:0.text: ... Alright. If I need you, I'll send word.

say:15:1522112013:1.text: For this poor child's sake, I'll put in a few good words. See if I can get Abundius to meet with you.
say:15:1522112013:1.source_cn: 看在这可怜孩子的份上，这一次我会替你们美言几句，让阿邦...

say:16:1522112014:0.text: Whether you can convince him, whether anything changes, that's up to you now.
say:16:1522112014:0.source_cn: 劝不劝得动他，能不能改变现状，这就要看你们的能耐了。

say:17:1522112015:0.text: But don't think I'm letting the corpse desecration slide! That debt still stands!
say:17:1522112015:0.source_cn: 当然，我的美言不包括你们亵渎尸体的事！这笔账我迟早会和...

say:19:1522112016:0.text: Mr. Bakis! How can you trust them? They sided with the Wildborn!
say:19:1522112016:0.source_cn: 比博学者，你怎么能这么轻易相信他们，他们可是在和兽人为...

say:22:1522112018:0.text: Keep a close eye on your Wildborn. She may be just a child, but not everyone in Halia will be so forgiving.
say:22:1522112018:0.source_cn: 看好你们身边的兽人。她还是个孩子，但难保呼临城内不会有...

say:23:1522112019:0.text: We understand. And thank you, for giving the Arcane Council a chance.
say:23:1522112019:0.source_cn: 你的好意我们感受到了。谢谢你愿意相信魔法师协会。
